title: Code Reviewer runner API, version 1
description: The wire format between the app and the runner. The app serves POST /api/runners/v1/claim, POST /api/runners/v1/jobs/{id}/heartbeat and POST /api/runners/v1/jobs/{id}/complete. Every request carries 'Authorization: Bearer <RUNNER_TOKEN>' and may carry 'X-Runner-Id' (a free-form id for bookkeeping, not a security boundary). A reader ignores fields it does not know, except where a definition says 'additionalProperties: false' (RunnerJobInput mirrors the closed job format of the runner). This file is the only source of the format: the app (app/integration-tests/compatibility) and the runner (runner/tests/contract) both validate against it, and contracts/examples holds one valid example per definition.

JobId.description: The id of a job (a UUID).

LeaseToken.description: Proof that the caller holds the job. New for every claim; required by heartbeat and complete. Secret: never log it.

Command.description: The commands the product executes. Since the removal of /ask, /improve and /describe only /review exists (a historical run keeps its original command in the database, never on the wire).

Engine.description: An engine a runner can run and may advertise in a claim (#195). pr-agent runs Diff Review, opencode runs Dynamic Review. An empty legacy claim means pr-agent only; a runner only advertises an engine its fail-closed startup self-check proved.

ReviewKind.description: The review kind a job was queued for (#195), pinned at enqueue time. Absent on a legacy Diff payload means diff. A runner is only handed a job whose kind one of its engines can run, and a Dynamic job is never silently run by PR-Agent.

ClaimRequest.description: The optional body of POST /api/runners/v1/claim (#195): the engines the calling runner can run. Absent or empty means ['pr-agent'] (a previous-release runner). Unknown or duplicated engine names are refused with 400 RUNNER_REQUEST_INVALID before any job is claimed. Unknown fields are ignored, as everywhere in v1.

DynamicReview.description: #195: the Dynamic options of a tagged job. Model, skill and the output limit only. A closed object: there is no fixed core, permission, executable command, endpoint or upstream URL here, so a job can never widen what the read-only agent may do. The skill is literal data.

ClaimBase.description: #195: the checkout facts a Dynamic job carries, pinned when the job was queued or claimed and bounded. `headSha` is the exact queued head; `baseRef` is the branch the pull request merges into (the exact base SHA is resolved during checkout, #196). `previousReviewedSha` is the head of the last successful review of the same kind (#199), or null. `attemptedShas` (#255, optional: absent means none, and the app leaves it out when empty) are the heads of the earlier jobs of the pull request that ran and did not succeed, newest first; the publisher accepts such a head as the state of the summary comment, because a run may have written it and then ended without success. `attemptedShasTruncated` (#257, optional: absent means false, and the app leaves it out unless it is true) says that more heads qualified than the list holds; only then does the publisher rewrite a bot-owned summary whose state head it cannot account for, with a full review, instead of refusing it. `comparison` is the *declared* mode: a hint for preparation, never proof that the comparison is complete — the checkout verifies that before it trusts it.

KnownRunnerErrorCode.description: The error codes the runner reports in a result (ErrorCode in the runner, plus runner_shutdown from the job loop). A caller branches on the code, never on a message. The app accepts any code of the form below and stores an unknown one as 'unknown' (the original stays in the stored result), so a newer runner never loses a result.

JobEnv.description: Extra options of the PR-Agent tools, as strings. The review tool's options (PR_REVIEWER__*) are used; a previous release's option families for the removed tools (PR_DESCRIPTION__*, PR_CODE_SUGGESTIONS__*, PR_QUESTIONS__*) are accepted for v1 compatibility and ignored. Nothing else is allowed here (credentials, endpoints and the model have their own fields).

RunnerJobInput.description: Exactly the job the runner reads on stdin (see runner/src/code_reviewer_runner/job.py). Closed: the runner refuses unknown fields. Contains secrets (git.token, llm.apiKey): only the claim response carries it.

args.description: Legacy field of the removed /ask command. A previous release may send it; the runner accepts and ignores it and never hands it to PR-Agent. This app sends no args.

maxTokens.description: The token budget of a review (it also bounds the fallback models, so it must fit the smallest window of the chain).

fallbackModels.description: Models to try, in order, when the main model fails. Optional; the app does not send it in the MVP (no fallback chain is decided), the runner accepts it.

allOf.description: A Diff job (reviewKind absent or 'diff') must not carry the tagged Dynamic fields; the runner refuses that and the schema agrees.

ClaimResponse.description: 200 from POST /api/runners/v1/claim. 204 without a body means there is nothing to do. Cache-Control is always no-store.

heartbeatIntervalSeconds.description: How often to send a heartbeat; the lease is several times longer.

tokenExpiresAt.description: When the git token stops working; null if it does not expire.

costUsd.description: The cost in US dollars, or null when it is not known. A Dynamic Review reports the exact sum of the charges its model provider reported for every call, and null when any call has no reported charge; it never estimates one.

RunnerResult.description: What the runner prints when a job ends (the output of code-reviewer-run-job), plus an optional errorMessage. The runner has redacted secrets from logTail; the app removes anything that still looks like one before it stores the result.

commentUrl.description: Link to the comment PR-Agent wrote; null when it could not be found (the run is still ok). A failed result may carry it too: review_state_truncated and review_text_truncated report a review that was posted but shortened.

errorCode.description: null if and only if ok is true. See KnownRunnerErrorCode.

errorMessage.description: Optional human readable detail for a failure; never contains secrets.

CompleteRequest.description: The whole request body must not exceed 65536 bytes (413 otherwise).

CompleteResponse.description: 200 for a completion and for the repetition of the same completion (alreadyCompleted: true); a different result for a completed job is 409. A result with errorCode runner_shutdown is not stored: the job is given back (status queued) and a repetition is 409, because the runner no longer holds the job.

status.description: succeeded or failed: the job is finished. queued: the runner reported runner_shutdown, the job was given back and waits for another runner (it fails instead if that was the last allowed attempt).

ApiErrorCode.description: Every error of the API has one of these codes. 401 RUNNER_UNAUTHORIZED, 400 RUNNER_ID_INVALID / RUNNER_REQUEST_INVALID, 404 RUNNER_JOB_NOT_FOUND, 409 RUNNER_LEASE_LOST / RUNNER_RESULT_CONFLICT, 413 RUNNER_BODY_TOO_LARGE, 503 RUNNER_GIT_ACCESS_UNAVAILABLE (with Retry-After), 500 RUNNER_INTERNAL_ERROR.

fields.description: For RUNNER_REQUEST_INVALID: which fields were refused and why (never their values).
